claim: The exact stack that passed the canonical rehearsal failed its first derived-timing perturbation at the lab-rival referee before any learned battle or training decision. A direct reproduction proved the cartridge battle was won; the old gate rejected a legal Squirtle DV outcome and exhausted its post-battle dialogue budget. This is a preserved route-robustness failure, not a model-prediction failure.

failure.message: The lab rival failed the bounded verified-victory gate.

diagnostic_reproduction.finding: The initial timing root changes the starter's legal determinant values. A level-six zero-stat-exp Squirtle has 21 through 23 max HP, so requiring exactly 21 was an accidental seed identity check. The same run reached the existing immutable post-win script and released-control boundary when allowed more bounded dialogue pulses.

repair.victory_contract: Retain observed trainer-battle entry, battle result zero, battled-rival event, Oaks Lab map, script 18, released controls, Squirtle identity, and level six. Accept only a living starter whose current HP is at most max HP and whose max HP is within the legal 21-to-23 DV range.
repair.bounded_progress: Increase the maximum rival confirm/dialogue pulses from 56 to 96; return immediately when the unchanged semantic victory gate passes.
repair.rom_free_regressions: Accept legal 21, 22, and 23 max-HP outcomes and a surviving damaged starter; reject zero HP, HP above max, max HP outside the legal range, a loss result, wrong species or level, missing event, wrong script, wrong map, or unreleased controls.
repair.next_gate: Regenerate the source-bound registry, pass the full repository gate, commit and push, then rerun a fresh uncounted derived-timing root. Counted v95 remains unopened.
